note: This project's own claims, declared so that scripts/audit_claims.py can check them the way it would check anyone else's. It is the worked example and the dogfood: run it with --run and it reports one MISMATCH, which is real and documented in experiments/PROP-EXP-MEM-007/CORRECTION.md.

claims.statement: Of the experiments carrying a verdict, ten reproduce exactly from the stored answers, one does not, and one rests on answers that were never stored.
claims.drift_note: Published first as nine reproduced. It was true when written and went stale as MEM-014 gained a verdict. The audit caught it within minutes of the claim being declared, which is the ordinary failure this tool exists for: not a number that was wrong, a number that stopped being right.

claims.statement: On the clinic document, the checklist instruction keeps 31.9 points more facts than a free summary at hop 3.
Merging independent chains recovers +11.6, +6.9 and +1.4 points over the mean of their sources.
